lenses.title: New surface and internal consistency
lenses.instructions: Prioritize the previous fix-up's edited sites, compact addendum, claims it makes about the rest of the target, and the neighboring rows or sentences. Then test repeated identifiers, paths, numbers, and internal cross-references that the edit may have left inconsistent.
lenses.first_review_instructions: There is no previous fix-up: the entire target is unreviewed surface. The structured lenses cover conformance, interfaces, and the document gate; sweep what they skip, especially detailed-design internal consistency, failure modes, threading/performance, testability, milestone staging, checklist coverage, repeated identifiers/paths/numbers, and claims one section makes about another.

lenses.title: Interface honesty and change-trigger regions
lenses.instructions: Check every consumed dependency contract against the dependency's manifest-selected binding region. Check every promise to consumers for enough detail to implement without guessing. Compare declared interface/change-trigger regions against the target's detailed design and decide whether those regions remain sufficient on their own. You own the touches_interface judgment.

lenses.title: Conformance map
lenses.instructions: Audit the target's contract-to-design mapping for zero unmapped in-scope requirements. Spot-check mapped rows against the cited authoritative source for semantic fidelity. Do not treat the absence of information the contract never asks for as a defect; do treat a row whose citation does not support its claim as one.

lenses.title: Document gate and template completeness
lenses.instructions: Measure every criterion in the target specification's manifest-selected document-gate selector literally. Check that every mandatory template section selected by the governing specification is present and substantive, and that every assigned open question has the required question/procedure/success-failure/fallback structure. A short complete section is not a defect; an empty named section is.

lenses.title: Scope discipline and binding decisions
lenses.instructions: Check that nothing declared in scope is silently dropped, nothing declared out of scope is designed here, binding decisions are not contradicted, and contract-visible behavior is not silently 'improved.' Input contradictions must be reported with a ruling and provenance rather than smoothed over.
